responsibility: This definition file is the authoritative list of AArch64 ISA extensions that GCC accepts in architecture and CPU option strings. For each extension it records the user-visible name, internal identifier, required prerequisite features, extra features implied by explicit +feature or +nofeature spellings, and the Linux /proc/cpuinfo feature strings used for autodetection, allowing option parsing, dependency closure computation, and native CPU detection to share one normalized extension database.
